task: Three siblings Maya, Leo, and Nina each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, cherry. Maya does not like cherry. Leo likes banana. Who likes apple?
Four coworkers Alex, Brooke, Carl, and Dana each drive a car of a different color: red, blue, green, black. Alex does not drive red. Brooke drives blue. Dana does not drive red. Who drives black?
Three books on a shelf—"History", "Poetry", and "Science"—are each written by a different author: Kim, Lee, Patel. "History" is not by Patel. "Poetry" is by Lee. Who wrote "Science"?

Four houses on a street are painted red, yellow, blue, and green. Tom does not live in the green house. Wendy lives in the red house. Victor does not live in the blue house. Uma does not live in the blue house. Who lives in the yellow house?
Three chefs Aaron, Bella, and Carlos each specialize in a different cuisine: Italian, Mexican, Thai. Aaron does not cook Thai. Bella cooks Mexican. Who cooks Italian?

Four students Maya, Noah, Owen, and Priya each received a different score: 85, 90, 95, 100. Maya did not score 95. Noah scored 90. Priya did not score 85. Owen did not score 95. Maya did not score 100. Who scored 100?
Three musicians Dan, Eva, and Finn each play a different instrument: guitar, piano, drums. Finn does not play piano. Dan plays guitar. Who plays drums?

Four planets Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars each have a flag of a different color: red, blue, green, yellow. Mercury's flag is not yellow. Venus's flag is blue. Earth's flag is not red. Mars's flag is not green. Which planet has the green flag?
Three runners Lily, Mark, and Nina each finish in a different position: 1st, 2nd, 3rd. Lily does not finish 2nd. Mark finishes ahead of Nina. Lily does not finish 3rd. Who finishes 1st?
Three friends Omar, Pam, and Quinn each wear a shirt of a different color: red, blue, green. Omar does not wear red. Pam wears blue. Who wears green?
Three coworkers—Maya, Alex, and Raj—each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, or cherry. Maya does not like the cherry. Alex likes the banana. Who likes the apple?
Four students—Lily, Noah, Owen, and Priya—each received a different grade: A, B, C, or D. Lily got a higher grade than Noah. Priya did not get B. Owen got C. Who received D?

Three chefs—Carlos, Dana, and Eli—each specialize in a different cuisine: Italian, Mexican, or Thai. Carlos does not specialize in Mexican. Carlos does not specialize in Thai. Dana does not specialize in Thai. Who specializes in Mexican?

Four books—Alpha, Beta, Gamma, and Delta—are placed on a shelf from left to right. Gamma is not at an end. Alpha is immediately left of Beta. Delta is to the right of Gamma. Which book is at the far right?
Three siblings—Maya, Omar, and Nina—each have a different favorite sport: soccer, tennis, or swimming. Maya does not like swimming. Omar likes tennis. Who likes soccer?

Four employees—Quinn, Riley, Sam, and Tara—each work a different shift: morning, afternoon, evening, or night. Quinn works the morning shift. Sam does not work the night shift. Riley works the evening shift. Who works the night shift?

Three planets—X, Y, and Z—each have a different number of moons: 1, 2, or 3. Planet X has more moons than planet Y. Planet Z does not have 2 moons. Planet Y does not have 1 moon. Which planet has exactly 1 moon?
Three friends—Ava, Ben, and Carl—each wear a different colored shirt: red, blue, or green. Ava does not wear red. Ben wears blue. Who wears green?

Four cars are parked in spots 1 through 4 from left to right. Each car is a different brand: Ford, Honda, Toyota, or BMW. The Honda is not in the first spot. The Ford is immediately to the right of the Toyota. The BMW is in the third spot. Which brand is in the first spot?
Three programmers—Lina, Mike, and Omar—each use a different programming language: Python, Java, or C++. Lina does not use C++. Mike uses Java. Who uses Python?
Three friends Alice, Bob, and Carol each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, cherry. Alice does not like cherry. Bob likes banana. Who likes apple?
Three siblings Maya, Nina, and Omar each own a different instrument: violin, piano, drums. Maya does not own the drums. Omar owns the violin. Who owns the piano?

Four friends Paul, Quinn, Rita, and Sam each wear a different colored shirt: red, blue, green, yellow. Paul wears red. Quinn does not wear blue. Rita does not wear yellow. Sam does not wear blue. Who wears green?

Three books—a novel, a biography, and a textbook—are placed left to right on a shelf. The novel is not on the leftmost position. The biography is not on the rightmost position. The textbook is not in the middle. Which book is in the middle?

Four employees Hana, Ian, Jack, and Kate each work in a different department: HR, Marketing, Sales, IT. Hana works in IT. Ian does not work in Sales. Jack works in Marketing. Which department does Kate work in?
Three kids Leo, Maya, and Noah each receive a balloon of a different color: red, blue, green. Maya gets the red balloon. Leo does not get the green balloon. Who gets the blue balloon?

Four parking spots numbered 1 to 4 each hold a car of a different brand: Toyota, Ford, Honda, BMW. Spot 2 holds the Ford. Spot 4 is not BMW. Spot 1 is not Toyota. Spot 4 is Toyota. Spot 1 is not Honda. Which brand is in spot 3?
Three chefs Omar, Priya, and Quinn each cook a different cuisine: Italian, Mexican, Japanese. Omar does not cook Mexican. Priya cooks Japanese. Who cooks Italian?

Four siblings Ryan, Sara, Tom, and Uma each have a different favorite season: spring, summer, autumn, winter. Sara's favorite is summer. Ryan does not like winter. Ryan does not like spring. Tom does not like spring. Uma does not like winter. Which season does Uma like?
Three rooms are painted different colors: red, yellow, blue. They are assigned to offices Alpha, Beta, and Gamma. Alpha is not red. Beta is yellow. Which color is Gamma?
Three chefs, Alex, Maya, and Raj, each bake a different dessert: cake, pie, mousse. Alex does not bake the mousse. Maya bakes the cake. Who bakes the pie?

Four siblings—Tom, Sam, Lily, and Max—each own a different colored bike: red, blue, green, yellow. The red bike is not Tom's. Sam rides the blue bike. The green bike belongs to Tom. Who rides the yellow bike?
On a shelf there are three books: a novel, a biography, and a poetry collection. The novel is not written by Lee. Kim's book is the biography. Whose book is the poetry collection?

Four employees—Anna, Ben, Cara, and Dan—are each assigned to a different project: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta. Anna is not on Project Gamma. Ben works on Project Alpha. Cara is on Project Delta. Who works on Project Beta?
Three planets—Orion, Vega, and Lyra—each have a distinct number of moons: 1, 2, or 3. Orion does not have 3 moons. Vega has 2 moons. Which planet has 1 moon?
Three students—Mia, Noah, and Owen—receive different grades: A, B, C. Noah does not get a C. Mia receives a B. Who gets the A?
Three musicians—Ruth, Sam, and Tina—play different instruments: violin, trumpet, drums. Sam does not play the drums. Tina plays the trumpet. Who plays the violin?
Three cities—Arcadia, Brookfield, and Cedar—have distinct populations: 10,000; 20,000; 30,000. Cedar does not have 30,000 residents. Brookfield has 10,000 residents. Which city has 20,000 residents?
In a drawer there are three shirts: red, blue, and green. The red shirt is not worn by Alex. Jordan wears the blue shirt. Who wears the green shirt?
Three programmers—Liam, Maya, and Noah—use different programming languages: Python, Java, C++. Maya does not use C++. Liam uses Java. Who uses Python?
Alex, Brooke, and Carlos each own a different type of car: sedan, coupe, or SUV. Alex does not own the SUV. Brooke owns the sedan. Who owns the coupe?

Maya, Noah, Owen, and Priya each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, cherry, or date. Maya's favorite is neither banana nor date. Noah's favorite is cherry. Priya's favorite is apple. Who likes banana?
Luis, Nina, and Omar each specialize in a different cuisine: Italian, Japanese, or Mexican. Luis does not specialize in Mexican. Nina specializes in Japanese. Who specializes in Italian?

Four books of different colors—red, blue, green, and yellow—are placed left to right on a shelf. The green book is not at an end. The red book is immediately left of the blue book. The yellow book is immediately left of the green book. Which color is in the third position?
Fiona, Greg, and Hannah each play a different instrument: piano, violin, or drums. Fiona does not play drums. Greg plays the violin. Who plays the piano?
Ian, Jenna, Kyle, and Leah each work in a different department: HR, Marketing, Sales, or Tech. Jenna works in Marketing. Ian does not work in Tech. Kyle works in Sales. Who works in HR?
Maya, Noah, and Owen each painted a different subject: landscape, portrait, or still life. Owen painted the portrait. Maya did not paint the landscape. Who painted the still life?

Four houses on a street are painted different colors: white, blue, green, and red. The green house is not at either end. The white house is immediately to the left of the blue house. The red house is at the rightmost end. Which color is the second house from the left?
Paolo, Quinn, and Rosa each specialize in a different dish: sushi, tacos, or pizza. Quinn does not specialize in sushi. Paolo specializes in pizza. Who specializes in tacos?

Sam, Tara, Uma, and Victor each have a different favorite season: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. Sam's favorite is not winter. Tara's favorite is summer. Victor's favorite is spring. Whose favorite season is autumn?
Three colleagues—Ava, Ben, and Carl—each have a different favorite fruit: apple, banana, or cherry. Ava does not like the cherry. Ben's favorite fruit is banana. Who's favorite fruit is apple?
Three drivers—Liam, Maya, and Noah—each own a car of a different color: red, blue, or green. Liam's car is not green. Maya's car is red. Who drives the blue car?

Three chefs—Eli, Fiona, and Greg—each specialize in a different cuisine: Italian, Mexican, or Thai. Eli is not the Thai specialist. Fiona specializes in Mexican cuisine. Who specializes in Italian cuisine?
Three roommates—Hank, Iris, and Jack—each have a different hobby: painting, knitting, or cycling. Iris does not knit. Jack's hobby is painting. Who's hobby is cycling?
Three detectives—Kim, Leo, and Maya—each solved a different case: theft, arson, or fraud. Kim solved the arson case. Leo did not solve the theft case. Who solved the theft case?
Three teachers—Nora, Owen, and Pam—each teach a different subject: math, history, or science. Owen teaches science. Nora does not teach math. Who teaches math?
Three pilots—Quinn, Ryan, and Sara—each fly a different type of aircraft: jet, propeller, or glider. Quinn flies the jet. Ryan does not fly the glider. Who flies the propeller aircraft?
Three artists—Tom, Uma, and Victor—each paint in a different style: abstract, realism, or surrealism. Uma does not paint surrealism. Victor paints realism. Who paints abstract?
Three bakers—Walt, Xena, and Yara—each bake a different pastry: croissant, danish, or eclair. Xena bakes the danish. Walt does not bake the eclair. Who bakes the eclair?
Three musicians—Zane, Amy, and Ben—each play a different instrument: guitar, drums, or saxophone. Amy plays the drums. Zane does not play the saxophone. Who plays the saxophone?
